title: Custom providers — round 3, last notes applied

steps.path: Settings → Assistant settings → Cloud providers → Add provider
steps.headline: Each provider in the list shows its address in brackets, the box is labelled "Provider", and models read "4 supported models".
steps.changed: The separate grey line under the title is gone. The menu rows read "Inception (api.inceptionlabs.ai)", and the picked one stays in the box that way.
steps.notice: You see where each provider connects while choosing, and the count says what it counts.

steps.path: Chat → model menu → search for a model that isn't listed
steps.headline: The empty search now says only "No models match" with your search, then the small button.
steps.changed: "New models can take up to a day to appear" is removed.
steps.notice: One short line, then the way forward.
